# Restaurante La Ragazza

## About
La Ragazza is an authentic Italian restaurant in Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia. Family-owned and operated since 1985, specializing in homemade pasta and traditional Italian recipes.

## Core Information
- **Name:** Restaurante La Ragazza
- **Type:** Italian Restaurant (Family-style, Artisanal)
- **Location:** Calle 19 #39-66, Barrio Camoa, Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia
- **Phone:** +57 313 349 4150
- **Price Range:** $$ (50,000-60,000 COP per person)
- **Established:** 1985

## Hours
- Monday: Closed
- Tuesday - Friday: 12:00-15:00, 18:00-21:30
- Saturday: 12:00-15:30, 18:00-21:30
- Sunday: 12:00-17:30

## Specialties
- Homemade fresh pasta (100% artisanal)
- Traditional Italian lasagna
- Tournedos (beef tenderloin)
- Italian desserts (Panna Cotta, Tiramisu)
- House wine selection
